purpose: Teach: 磯/黒髪/アジサイ/めがね/山菜/乳製品/谷間/偉人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと磯で貝を拾ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad and I used to pick shells down at the shore.
lines.style: Soft, distant voice reaching back through time. Slow, deliberate delivery. Eyes somewhere else — not quite present. Warm undercurrent but turned inward.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃は黒髪が艶やかでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa — your black hair was so glossy back then, wasn't it, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate correction. A small smile in the voice. She's not tracking his memory, following her own. Warm and slightly teasing — the kind of comment made after sixty years of marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお庭にアジサイを植えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad planted hydrangeas in the garden.
lines.style: Same distant quality as before. The words arrive slowly, like he's watching the scene unfold as he speaks. A small pause before each image. Tender, not sad.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年はめがねを大事にされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were always so careful with your glasses in your later years, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Her own thread of memory, warm and specific. Not correcting him, but gently inhabiting her own recollection. A slight lift at the question-mark — inviting agreement, not seeking it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと山菜を採りに行ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad and I went to pick wild vegetables in the mountains.
lines.style: The same measured, dreamy cadence. Each memory is offered like a small gift. His voice doesn't rush. There's a stillness underneath — peace with these images.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、乳製品があまりお得意ではなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you used to tell the grandchildren about the local heroes, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly proud. She's speaking of a version of him she cherished. Softer landing on the final 'dear' — intimate, sure of him. No question in it, really — just agreement wrapped in affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと谷間の温泉旅行をしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad and I took a hot spring trip to the valley.
lines.style: Voice opens slightly with this one — more present than before, but still looking backward. A breath of pleasure enters the delivery. The memory carries warmth he can still feel.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、地域の偉人のお話を孫にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you never much cared for dairy, did you, dear?
lines.style: Close, intimate observation. Amused recognition — this is a real detail about him she remembers. Delivered with quiet certainty and affection. The teasing of someone who knows.
